messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — elevated 5xx spike detected on inference-gateway-prod. Error rate 5xx 12% over 1m, 429 spike 18%. Threshold breached.

alex.g: paging @oncall. seeing 5xx + gateway timeouts. latency up.
oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs.

priya: I'm pulling rate-limit metrics now — looks like a recent ACL/ratelimit rollout at 2026-03-12T20:14Z to a new token bucket on /v1/generate rolled out incorrectly; token-bucket applied at upstream proxy not per-tenant. That's causing internal retries and backlog.

matt: confirmed. Kibana: gateway 502/504 correlates with increase in 429s from auth-service. chart: 429s -> backlog -> 5xx.

alex.g: impact estimate? which customers?

priya: ~7% of requests globally, highest in eu-west-1. A couple of large tenants (tenant-42, tenant-payments) showing increased error rates.

oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) disable the new token-bucket rule 2) increase gateway worker pool 3) enable fallback older-model route for heavy tenants. I'll start 1.

(oncall runs)
oncall: disabling rule... `cfgctl rollback ratelimit/2026-03-12-20` -> success :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Deploybot: rollback ratelimit/2026-03-12-20 completed on gateway-cluster-prod-1 by oncall at 1768785480.

priya: after rollback 429s dropping. but still seeing elevated 5xx from connection timeouts due to the backlog — giving it a minute.

sophie: can we throttle retries on client side? add Retry-After  and reduce concurrency to prevent self-amplifying retries.

matt: scaling gateway: `kubectl scale deployment gateway --replicas=12 -n prod` -> in progress.

alex.g: can we route tenant-payments to dedicated pool? use tag fallback route 'dedicated-slowpath'

priya: creating route override for tenant-payments now. `routectl create override --tenant tenant-payments --route dedicated-slowpath` -> applied.

cs-luis: heads-up — customer success: notifying tenant-payments and tenant-42 now. sending templated note about degraded service and mitigation underway.

cs-luis: message sent. asked for contact if payment flows blocked. :email:

oncall: 5xx dropping to 2.8% from 12% in 8m. 429s at baseline. latency returning. still monitoring.

alex.g: what changed to cause token-bucket to be applied upstream? priya: config mis-scoped a global policy flag `apply_to_edge=true` set in the rollout manifest. Should have been per-route. human error plus PR review miss.

matt: file a mitigation ticket and block further ratelimit rollouts until postmortem.

(oncall) :thumbsup: going to keep extra margin for next 30m and watch SLOs. 

pnote: commands used:
```
cfgctl rollback ratelimit/2026-03-12-20
kubectl scale deployment gateway --replicas=12 -n prod
routectl create override --tenant tenant-payments --route dedicated-slowpath
```

priya: root cause: mis-scoped rate-limit policy + edge application triggered cascading 429s -> retries -> backlog -> 502/504 in gateway.

alex.g: action items — (1) revert PR + add tests to ensure policy scoping (priya) (2) postmortem doc with timeline and customer impact (alex.g) (3) add live runbook step to disable ratelimit quickly (matt) (4) notify legal/ops for high-impact tenant if SLA hit (cs-luis).

cs-luis: collecting impacted tenant list, will attach to PM later.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and mitigated. Monitoring holds for 60m before close.

oncall: Confirmed stable at 30m: 5xx <1% and latency normal. paging cleared. :white_check_mark:

alex.g: thanks all. will start postmortem draft and link metrics, commit changes to rollout gating.

sophie: leaving a note: consider circuit-breaker on upstream auth-service to prevent retry storms.

priya: adding that to roadmap.
